spec.name: pump_bracket
spec.description: Wall-mounted pump bracket: back face (z=0) bolted over full area, pump weight carried on a 60x40 mm footprint on the top face (y=100) centred at x=80, z=35. Gravity acts in -y.

supports.note: Back face z=0 bolted to wall over its full area

loads.note: NOMINAL magnitude: brief gives no pump mass/force. Direction is gravity (-y, y up). For single-load compliance minimisation the optimal layout is independent of load magnitude, so 1000 N only scales displacements/compliance. Replace with the actual pump weight (plus any dynamic factor) before any stress or deflection check.

passive.note: Keep solid material under the pump footprint so the seat exists in the result (2 elements thick)

assumptions: Pump load magnitude not specified in brief; nominal 1000 N downward used. Topology is magnitude-invariant for this single linear load case, but compliance/stress values are not meaningful until the real pump weight is supplied.
Load direction taken as pure gravity (-y); no pump vibration, torque or lateral loads included since none were given.
Solid mounting pad added under the footprint so the pump has a seat.
